title: Spine Plates and Bookworms
request: Average the known page counts on this cart to one decimal, ignoring '?' and 'missing' plates. Bookworms ate the numbers; magpies changed the case and left spaces around the writing.
objective: Clean text before excluding missing readings and averaging numeric counts.
hints: A chewed plate is not a book of zero pages; a differently written missing marker is still missing.
strip removes surrounding spaces and lower makes case consistent; are.not_equal_to can then exclude both missing markers.
Replace pages with make_array(*[plate.strip().lower() for plate in shelf.column('pages')]), exclude '?' and 'missing', convert readable plates with int, then round the mean.
inputCode:
import random
from datascience import Table, make_array
titles = ['The Cartographer\'s Apology', 'Every Ladder in the Stacks', 'Migrations of the Paper Crane', 'Fieldwork at the Edge of Sleep', 'A Catalogue of Kind Machines', 'The Long Shelf of Tuesdays', 'The Last Card in the Drawer']
n = random.randint(4, 7)
picked = random.sample(titles, n)
plates = [str(random.randrange(120, 420, 2)) for _ in range(n)]
for index in random.sample(range(n), random.randint(0, n - 2)):
    plates[index] = random.choice(['?', 'missing', ' Missing ', 'MISSING  '])
shelf = Table().with_columns('title', make_array(*picked), 'pages', make_array(*plates))
